summary: NewcelX Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release about receiving a Brazilian patent for its cell selection technology covering NCEL-101 in type 1 diabetes. No transaction, merger, tender offer, or special-situation event is described. The filing is a routine IP update and does not constitute any of the enumerated categories. The filing is a foreign private issuer report equivalent to a U.S. current report on Form 8-K but without triggering a special-situation classification.
